download.description: Download the TMPlayer Music APK for Android 6.0 and newer from GitHub Releases, with its SHA-256 to check. Unofficial, not affiliated with Telegram.
download.lede: One APK for Android phones and tablets, straight from GitHub Releases. It is the only place the app is published.
download.obtainium_how: In Obtainium, add {a1} as an app source. Turn on its pre-release option only if you want the test versions.
download.obtainium_text: {a1} installs the APK straight from the releases and tells you when a newer one is out. On a phone that has it, the badge below adds the app for you.
download.previous_none: There are no earlier releases yet. {a1} lists each one as it comes.
download.releases_text: Every build, with its notes, is on GitHub. The changelog on this site has the same releases in plain words.
download.sha_text: The SHA-256 above is the checksum of this exact file. Run one of these commands in the folder the APK is in, and compare the result with it. GitHub shows the same value beside the file on the release page.
download.short_h: A short link for your phone
download.short_text: On the phone, type {a1} in the browser. It goes to the latest release on GitHub, where the APK is listed under Assets.
download.title: Download: TMPlayer Music
download.updates_text1: The APK from GitHub can update itself. It checks for a newer release when the app opens, offers it, and Android asks you to confirm before anything is installed. You can turn the check off in Settings, Updates.
download.updates_text2: A build from a store has no updater: only the GitHub APK updates itself. TMPlayer Music is not in any store yet.

faq.albumsplit_a: Albums group by album artist, album and year, read from the tags in the files. If two files spell the album artist differently, or carry different years, they land in two albums. The app shows what the tags say and does not rewrite them.
faq.albumsplit_q: Why is an album split in two?
faq.big_a: Yes. Audio streams from Telegram as you play it and is never loaded whole, so a big file starts within seconds and seeks before the download ends. It does need free space for the cache: if there is not enough, the app says how much the track needs and how much is free. Set the cache limit in Settings, Storage.
faq.big_q: Do hi-res and very large files work?
faq.change_a: No. It does not post, send, react or mark anything as read. Removing a chat from the app, Free up space and Log out never delete or change a message in Telegram.
faq.change_q: Does it change anything in my chats?
faq.chats_a: Only the chats you pick, on the first run or later in Manage chats. Nothing is scanned until you pick a chat, and only the audio in it is read. Your other messages and your contacts are not read.
faq.cost_a: No. It is free, with no ads of its own and no paid tier, and every feature is free for everyone. Chipping in is voluntary and unlocks nothing. {a1}.
faq.description: Answers about TMPlayer Music: whether it is official, how signing in works, what it reads and sends, what it costs, which formats play, and how updates arrive.
faq.formats_a: MP3, FLAC, M4A, Ogg, Opus, WAV and AIFF. The app brings FFmpeg decoders for what a phone lacks, such as FLAC and Opus before Android 8, and ALAC. Voice messages are never in the library, and clips under 30 seconds are hidden until you turn them on in Settings, Library.
faq.g_updates: Updates and where to get it
faq.lede: Short answers about the account, the cost, playback and the library. If yours is not here, the guides and the issue tracker are next.
faq.missing_a: Only the chats you picked are read, voice messages and files Telegram restricts are skipped, and clips under 30 seconds are hidden until you turn them on. A big chat can also still be scanning. {a1} goes through each cause.
faq.more_p: Try {a1}, or look at what the app does in {a2}. If neither helps, open an issue and say what happened.
faq.nolength_a: Some files do not say how long they are. The length is then unknown, not zero: the track is still listed and plays. Looking up lyrics needs the length, so such a track gets lyrics only from its tags or a .lrc file.
faq.nolength_q: Why does a track show no length?
faq.official_a: No. It is unofficial and not affiliated with Telegram. It is a separate player that reads the chats you pick, with your own Telegram account.
faq.official_q: Is TMPlayer Music an official Telegram app?
faq.open_a: Yes. It is free software under the GNU GPL 3.0, with an exception that allows linking with OpenSSL. The code is on {a1}.
faq.privacy_a: The library index, your playlists, favourites and play counts, the queue and a cache of audio, all on the phone. Log out or uninstall to clear them. {a1} says what leaves the phone, and {a2} covers lawful use and takedown requests.
faq.privacy_q: What does it keep on my phone, and where do I read more?
faq.signin_a: You sign in inside the app, with your own account, as you would in any Telegram app: a code, your two-step password if you have one, or a QR code scanned from Telegram on another device. There is no account of ours and no server of ours in between, so we never hold your password. Log out in the app to end the session, or end it in Telegram under Settings, Devices.
faq.stores_a: Not yet. Builds are published on the GitHub Releases page and you install the APK yourself. It runs on Android 6.0 and newer. {a1}.
faq.stores_q: Is it in an app store?
faq.title: Questions: TMPlayer Music
faq.update_a: The app checks GitHub for a newer release when it opens, at most every six hours, and offers it. Update now downloads it, checks that it is signed with the same key, and hands it to Android's installer, which asks you to confirm. The check can be turned off in Settings, Updates. {a1} for Obtainium and installing by hand.
faq.update_a__a1: The install page has the steps
faq.upload_a: Besides Telegram itself, two things leave the phone. When a track has no lyrics or cover in its file or chat, its title, artist and album (and its length, for lyrics) go to our lookup service; chat names, file names and your account are never sent, and Settings, Lyrics has the switch that turns it off. And the update check asks GitHub when the app opens, which you can turn off in Settings, Updates.
faq.upload_q: Does it upload or send anything?
faq.versions_a: When the same song is in several files, such as a lossless copy and a smaller one, they are one row with a Versions sheet behind it. Tap a version to play it, and the sheet says why one plays by default. Live, remix and other recordings are separate rows, and different artists are never folded together.
faq.versions_q: Why are some tracks grouped as Versions?

features.cta_p: Free and open source, for Android 6.0 and newer. It reads only the chats you pick.
features.data_backup_p: One file with your favourites, playlists, play counts and chosen chats. Songs, covers and offline copies are not in it: they come back from your chats. Restoring can merge with what you have or replace it, after a confirmation.
features.data_cache_p: Audio is kept in a cache so it does not download twice. Settings, Storage shows how much is used and free, and lets you set how big the cache may grow.
features.data_free_p: Deletes the cached audio. Your tracks stay in the library and stream again when you play them. Nothing in Telegram is touched, and tracks you kept offline stay.
features.data_intro: What the app keeps is on your phone, and you decide how much.
features.data_offline_p: Keep a track, an album, a playlist or a whole chat on the phone. It checks the free space first and says how much is needed. Kept tracks play with no connection.
features.data_remove_h: Removing a chat removes its tracks
features.data_remove_p: Take a chat out in Manage chats and its tracks leave the library, while your messages in Telegram are not touched. Log out clears the library on the phone.
features.description: What TMPlayer Music does: one library from the chats you pick, playback that starts while the file downloads, synced lyrics, a cache you control. Unofficial, not affiliated with Telegram.
features.lede: A player for the audio files already in your own Telegram chats. Here is what is in the app today, group by group, and what it leaves alone on purpose.
features.lib_albums_p: Albums group by album artist, album and year, read from the tags in the files (ID3, FLAC, Ogg, MP4, WAV and AIFF). The text encoding is detected, so titles in any script read correctly.
features.lib_chats_p: Each chat you pick opens as a playlist of its tracks, in message order, Oldest first or Newest first, with Play and Shuffle.
features.lib_lists_p: One library across your chats, with an A to Z bar to jump to a letter. Artists credited together are split into each artist.
features.lib_search_p: Search songs, albums and artists, with your recent searches a tap away. It looks only inside the chats you picked.
features.lib_versions_p: The same song in several files is one row with a Versions sheet behind it. Tap a version to play it. Live, remix and other recordings stay separate rows.
features.library_intro: One library built from the chats you pick, and a few ways to move around in it.
features.lyr_lookup_p: When a track has no lyrics or cover in its file or chat, its title, artist and album (and its length, for lyrics) go to our own lookup service, which asks LRCLIB, MusicBrainz and the Cover Art Archive. Chat names, file names and your account are never sent. One switch, in Settings, Lyrics, turns it off.
features.lyr_synced_p: Lyrics come from the file's tags, or from a .lrc file with the same name in the same chat, and follow the track line by line when they are timed, the current line lit.
features.lyr_timing_p: Word by word highlighting when the lyrics carry word times, a timing offset for each track, and sharing a line or all the lyrics as text.
features.lyrics_intro: From the file or from a lookup you can switch off.
features.not1: It has no catalogue, no store and no recommendations of what to listen to.
features.not2: It does not search public channels. Nothing is scanned until you pick a chat, and only the chats you pick are read.
features.not3: It does not post, send, react or mark anything as read in your chats.
features.not4: Voice messages are never in the library. Clips under 30 seconds and voice recordings sent as files are hidden until you turn them on.
features.not5: Files Telegram restricts are skipped, and a file a chat does not allow to be saved cannot be kept offline.
features.not6: It is not an official Telegram app: it is unofficial and not affiliated with Telegram.
features.notdo_p: These are choices, not gaps. They keep the app to the files you already have.
features.pl_fav_p: Hold a song, then Add to favourites. They show on Home and in their own tab.
features.pl_home_p: Speed dial keeps the tracks you come back to one tap away, with Recently added, Recently played and Shuffle all below.
features.pl_lists_p: Hold a song, then Add to playlist. Deleting a playlist keeps the songs. Export one as M3U8, or import a list: only songs already in your library are added, and nothing is downloaded.
features.play_background_p: Keeps playing with the screen off, with the notification, lock screen and headset controls.
features.play_nothing_p: Nothing starts playing when a headset or a car connects, or when the app connects to Telegram.
features.play_queue_p: Reorder it, take tracks out, or clear it. The queue is saved, and comes back paused when you open the app again.
features.play_sound_p: An equalizer with presets, playback speed with a keep-pitch switch, skip silence, and loudness normalisation from the ReplayGain tags in the file. A track without tags plays as it is.
features.play_stream_p: A track starts within seconds while the file is still downloading, and seeking works before the download ends. Big and hi-res files stream, they are not loaded whole.
features.playback_intro: Built for files that live in a chat and arrive over the network.
features.playlists_intro: Keep what you come back to.
features.shot_account_alt: The account menu open over Home: the signed in account, Settings, Manage chats, Send logs, About and Log out.
features.shot_lyrics_alt: The lyrics page of Now Playing: lines of lyrics with the current one in bold white.
features.shot_nowplaying_alt: Now Playing: a large cover, the track title and artist, a seek bar and the playback buttons.
features.shot_playlists_alt: The Playlists tab: a New playlist button and a list of playlists with their song counts.
features.shot_songs_alt: The Library on its Songs tab: tracks with covers, artists and lengths, and an A to Z index on the side.
features.sleep_end_h: At the end of the track
features.sleep_end_p: Or pause when the track playing now ends, repeat one included.
features.sleep_intro: For falling asleep to a queue.
features.sleep_minutes_p: Pause playback after the number of minutes you choose. It works with the screen off, and the volume fades down before the pause.
features.title: Features: TMPlayer Music

install.blocked_code_a: Telegram sends the code to your other Telegram apps first, not by SMS. If you are signed in nowhere else, or Telegram will not send one here, use Scan a QR code instead.
install.blocked_notinstalled_a: The copy on the phone was signed with a different key, for example a build somebody made themselves. Uninstall it first, then install the APK from the Releases page.
install.blocked_notinstalled_q: "App not installed" over an older copy
install.blocked_parse_a: The download was cut short, or the phone is older than Android 6.0. Download the APK again and check its SHA-256 against the one on the Download page.
install.blocked_parse_q: "There is a problem parsing the package"
install.blocked_protect_a: Play Protect warns about apps it has not seen before. Check the SHA-256 against the Download page: if it matches, the file is the one on GitHub, and you can choose to install it anyway. A phone managed by a work or school account may not allow it at all.
install.blocked_protect_q: Play Protect warns about the app
install.blocked_source_a: Open the switch Android points you to: Install unknown apps for your browser or file manager, or Unknown sources on Android 7 and older. Allow it, then open the APK again. You can switch it off once the app is installed.
install.blocked_source_q: Android says installing from this source is not allowed
install.blocked_still: Still stuck? {a1}, with the app version (Settings, About), your phone and its Android version, and what happened.
install.cta_short: Or type {a1} in the browser on the phone.
install.description: Install TMPlayer Music on Android 6.0 or newer: download the APK, allow the install, sign in and pick your chats. Unofficial, not affiliated with Telegram.
install.howto_description: Install the TMPlayer Music APK on an Android phone or tablet, sign in with your own account and pick the chats to read.
install.lede: TMPlayer Music is not in any store yet, so you install its APK from GitHub Releases. It runs on phones and tablets with Android 6.0 or newer.
install.perm_awake_why: So playback carries on with the screen off.
install.perm_boot_why: Only so the optional sponsor reminder's daily check, which is off unless you turn it on in Settings, survives a restart. Nothing runs at boot itself.
install.perm_install_why: Only for updating: the GitHub APK hands the update it downloaded and checked to Android's installer, which always asks you to confirm. Builds for a store leave it out.
install.perm_internet_why: To reach Telegram, stream your tracks and know when you are offline.
install.perm_none: It does not ask for storage, photos, audio files, contacts, location, camera or microphone. Tracks stream from Telegram as you play them and are cached in the app's own storage: you set how big the cache may grow in Settings, and Free up space empties it.
install.perm_notifications_why: The playback notification with its controls, and the progress of Keep offline. Android 13 and newer ask you; playback works without it.
install.perm_service_why: To keep playing with the screen off or in another app, and to fetch tracks for Keep offline while the app is out of sight.
install.perm_vibrate_why: The small haptic click on play, skip and the seek bar.
install.permissions_text: This is every permission the app declares. Android asks you about Notifications on Android 13 and newer; the others are granted when you install.
install.step1_text: On your phone, use the button on the Download page, or open music.tmplayer.org/apk in the browser and tap the APK listed under Assets.
install.step2_text: Open the file when it finishes. The first time, Android asks to let your browser or file manager install apps: allow it, then tap Install. On Android 7 and older the switch is Unknown sources in Settings, Security.
install.step2_title: Open it and allow the install
install.step3_text: Android may show a Play Protect prompt for an app that comes from outside Google Play. If you got the APK from the Download page or the GitHub release, and its SHA-256 matches, you can choose to install it anyway.
install.step3_title: Answer Play Protect, if it asks
install.step4_text: Use your own account: your phone number, then the code Telegram sends to your other devices, and your two-step password if you set one. Or choose Scan a QR code and scan it from the Telegram app on another phone: Settings, Devices, Link Desktop Device.
install.step4_title: Open the app and sign in
install.step5_text: Choose the chats that hold your audio files. Saved Messages is a good first one. Only the chats you pick are read, and you can change them later in Manage chats.
install.title: Install on Android: TMPlayer Music
install.uninstall_text: Uninstall it like any app. That removes the library index, the cache and the sign in from the phone. To end the session on Telegram's side too, log out in the app first, or end it under Settings, Devices in Telegram.
install.update_text1: The APK from GitHub checks for a newer release when the app opens, at most every six hours, and offers it. Update now downloads it, checks that it is signed with the same key as the app you have, and hands it to Android's installer, which asks you to confirm. Turn the check off in Settings, Updates. Get test versions, in the same place, offers the pre-releases too.
install.update_text2: You can also download the newer APK yourself, or let Obtainium do it, and install it over the old one. Your library, playlists and sign in stay. Android refuses an APK signed with a different key, so only install builds from this project's Releases page over each other.

legal.credits_1: This site is set in Poppins, under the SIL Open Font License, and serves the font from its own domain. The Buy Me a Coffee cup and the Google Pay mark are those services' own artwork, shown only as links to them. The screenshots use an invented library: every track, album and artist name in them is made up.
legal.description: Lawful use of TMPlayer Music, an unofficial player for the audio files in your own Telegram chats: what it does and does not do, rights holders, licences.
legal.is_1: It plays audio that is already in chats you are in, with your own Telegram account.
legal.is_2: It reads only the chats you pick, and nothing is scanned until you pick one.
legal.is_3: It leaves out any file Telegram marks as restricted.
legal.isnt_1: It provides, hosts, uploads or sells no audio.
legal.isnt_2: It has no catalogue, no search of public channels and no recommendations of what to listen to, and it does not point you to chats or channels.
legal.isnt_3: It does not bypass Telegram's permissions, restrictions, paywalls or encryption.
legal.isnt_4: It does not post, send, react or mark anything as read on your behalf.
legal.lede: TMPlayer Music is a player for the audio files already in your own Telegram chats. It provides no audio and no access to chats you are not in.
legal.licence_1: TMPlayer Music is free software under the {a1}, version 3 or, at your option, any later version, with an {a2} because TDLib links OpenSSL. The source is on GitHub and each release is built from it. Parts of the code come from its sibling, TMPlayer, under the same licence.
legal.licence_2: The libraries bundled in the app, their licences and where to get their source are listed in {a1}.
legal.lyrics_1: Lyrics shown from online lookups come from LRCLIB, and covers from the Cover Art Archive. Their rights stay with their owners. The app shows them on your device and keeps them only there, and "Clear saved lyrics" and "Clear saved covers" in Settings, Lyrics remove them.
legal.names_1: TMPlayer Music is an unofficial app that uses the Telegram API. It is not made by, affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to Telegram FZ-LLC. Telegram and the other names on this site, among them LRCLIB, MusicBrainz, Cover Art Archive, GitHub, Buy Me a Coffee and Google Pay, belong to their owners and are used only to say what they are.
legal.own_1: Use TMPlayer Music only with audio you own, audio you have permission to listen to, or audio otherwise available to you under the law that applies to you. You are responsible for what you play and for having the right to it. The app grants no rights to anything it plays.
legal.own_2: How you came to have a file in a chat is between you, the chat and Telegram. The app only plays what is there, the way Telegram's own player would.
legal.rights_1: The app hosts nothing, so a file in a Telegram chat is for Telegram and the chat's admins to deal with, through Telegram's own reporting tools. If you believe something published on this website or in the GitHub repository infringes your rights, write to {a1} with the exact address, what you own, and how to reach you.
legal.terms_1: TMPlayer Music is provided as is, without warranty of any kind, to the extent the law allows. The full terms are sections 15 and 16 of the licence.
legal.terms_2: Your use of Telegram through the app stays under {a1}, and the app follows {a2}.

privacy.choices_1: Turn the lookups off in Settings, Lyrics.
privacy.choices_2: Turn the update check off in Settings, Updates.
privacy.choices_3: Pick only the chats you want read, and change them in Manage chats.
privacy.choices_4: Log out to clear the library from the phone, or end the session in Telegram under Settings, Devices.
privacy.contact_1: Ask on the project's {a1}. The app is open source, so every claim on this page can be checked in the code.
privacy.description: What TMPlayer Music keeps on your phone, what it sends to Telegram and to its lyrics and cover lookup, and what this website does. No ads, no analytics.
privacy.device_1: The library index: the titles, artists, albums and covers read from the start of each file in the chats you picked.
privacy.device_2: Your settings, favourites, playlists, play counts and the queue.
privacy.device_3: The cache of audio, whose size you set, and anything you chose to keep offline.
privacy.device_4: Lyrics and covers found online, so a song is looked up once.
privacy.device_end: Logging out clears the library on the device, playlists and favourites included, and nothing in your Telegram chats changes. Uninstalling the app removes everything it stored. A backup file only exists if you make one, and it stays where you save it.
privacy.device_lead: These are kept on the phone and nowhere else:
privacy.lede: TMPlayer Music keeps your library on your phone, talks to Telegram with your own account, and has no ads, no analytics and no account of ours. This page says what leaves the phone, and when.
privacy.logs_1: Nothing is sent by itself. "Send logs" in Settings, and on an error screen, writes a text file of recent app logs, and you pick the app it goes to. Chat names, numbers, file names and secrets are taken out first. The app has no crash reporting service.
privacy.lookup_1: When a track has no lyrics or cover in its file or chat, the app can ask our lookup service. It sends the track's title, artist and album, and its length for lyrics. It never sends a chat name, a chat id, a file name or anything about your account.
privacy.lookup_2: The service asks LRCLIB for lyrics, and MusicBrainz and the Cover Art Archive for covers, and passes the answer back. It does not log who asked, has no analytics and stores nothing about you. It keeps only the answer it got, in a short-lived edge cache under a hash of the track's details, so the next person asking for the same song does not reach those services again. To slow a single noisy client it counts requests in memory by a coarse bucket made from part of a hash of the network address; the address itself is never stored, logged or passed on.
privacy.lookup_3: This is on by default. The first time lyrics are shown the app asks, and "Not now" turns it off. You can change it at any time in Settings, Lyrics, with the switch "Look up lyrics and covers online". Covers are fetched on Wi-Fi, or on mobile data if you allowed that for track details. With the switch off nothing is sent, and lyrics from the file's tags or from a .lrc file in the chat still show. "Clear saved lyrics" and "Clear saved covers" in the same place empty what was kept on the device.
privacy.lookup_h: Lyrics and covers: our lookup service
privacy.row_github_what: The request for the latest release, which holds nothing about you.
privacy.row_github_when: When the app opens, at most every six hours, unless you turn it off.
privacy.row_logs_what: A text file of recent logs, with names and numbers removed.
privacy.row_logs_when: Only when you tap Send logs and pick an app.
privacy.row_lookup_what: A track's title, artist and album, and its length for lyrics.
privacy.row_lookup_when: Only for a track with no lyrics or cover of its own, and only while the switch is on.
privacy.row_tg_what: What a Telegram client sends: your sign in, and reads and downloads of the chats you picked.
privacy.row_tg_when: Whenever the app is in use.
privacy.short_1: No account of ours: you sign in with your own Telegram account, and only to Telegram.
privacy.short_2: No ads, no analytics and no crash reporting service, in the app or on this site.
privacy.short_3: Your library, playlists and settings stay on the device.
privacy.short_4: One lookup service of ours, for lyrics and covers. It gets a track's title, artist, album and length, never a chat name or a file name, and one switch turns it off.
privacy.site_1: music.tmplayer.org sets no cookies, keeps nothing in your browser and runs no analytics, trackers or ad scripts. Its fonts and images come from its own domain. It is hosted on Cloudflare Pages, which, like any host, sees the address and request of each visit.
privacy.site_2: The Buy Me a Coffee window is the one outside piece. Its frame loads from buymeacoffee.com only when you point at, focus or tap a coffee link (never when your browser asks to save data), and what happens inside it is covered by Buy Me a Coffee's own policy. The Google Pay mark on the UPI button is an image on this domain, so nothing reaches Google; the UPI link opens your own payment app. Links to GitHub and other sites leave this one when you follow them.
privacy.table_h: Where things go, at a glance
privacy.telegram_1: The app is a Telegram client built on TDLib. You sign in with your own account (phone number and code, a two-step password if you have one, or a QR code), and it reads and downloads the audio in the chats you pick, the same way any Telegram app does. Telegram receives what a client sends it; its own policy covers that.
privacy.telegram_2: Nothing passes through a server of ours on the way. Chats you did not pick are not scanned. The app does not post, send, react or mark anything as read on your behalf, and it does not read your contacts.
privacy.title: Privacy: TMPlayer Music
privacy.updates_1: The APK from GitHub checks the project's GitHub releases when it opens, at most every six hours, so it can offer a newer version. GitHub sees that request as it sees any visit to its site. Turn it off in Settings, Updates. Nothing about your library or account is in the request.

security.description: How to report a security problem in TMPlayer Music privately, what is in scope, which versions get fixes, and how to check that an APK is the real one.
security.lede: Found a security problem in TMPlayer Music? Please report it privately, so it can be fixed before anyone can use it.
security.report_1: Do not open a public issue for a security problem. Report it privately instead:
security.report_2: through GitHub, with {a1} on the project's Security tab (the quickest way), or
security.report_4: Include the app version, the phone and its Android version, what an attacker could do, and the steps to reproduce it. You will get a reply within a week. Once a fix is out, the report can be credited to you if you like.
security.scope_1: TMPlayer Music talks to Telegram through TDLib and keeps your library on your device. The one service of its own is the lyrics and cover lookup, and it only ever receives a track's title, artist, album and duration. Problems in the app or in that service are in scope.
security.scope_2: Problems in Telegram itself, in TDLib or in LRCLIB belong upstream, though a heads up is welcome when this app is affected. A bug that is not a security problem is better reported on the {a1}.
security.signed_1: The APK on the GitHub release page is the one to install. Every release is built by the project's release workflow and checked to be signed with the release key before it is published. Android refuses to install an update signed with a different key over the app, and the app's own updater checks the signature the same way before it hands the file to Android's installer, which asks you to confirm.
security.signed_2: To check a download, compare its SHA-256 with the one GitHub shows beside the file on the release page. On Linux or macOS run {a1}; on Windows, {a2}; on the phone, a file manager or hash app that shows SHA-256 will do. The latest release is {version}, and its SHA-256 is:
security.signed_3: If the two differ, do not install it: download it again from the {a1}, and tell us if it still differs.
security.signed_h: Checking that an APK is the real one
security.title: Security: TMPlayer Music
security.versions_1: Only the latest release, and the latest test version (vX.Y.Z-beta.N) while one is out, get fixes. Please check that the problem still happens on the newest build from the Releases page before reporting.

trouble.blocked_card: Sign-in stays on Connecting, or the library will not load, on one network and not on another.
trouble.blocked_cause1: The network blocks Telegram. Some school, work, public Wi-Fi and country networks do, and the Telegram app fails there too.
trouble.blocked_cause2: The phone has no real connection behind the Wi-Fi, such as a login page that has not been completed, or mobile data that is used up.
trouble.blocked_cause3: Telegram has asked the app to slow down. The message says how long to wait, and the list carries on by itself afterwards.
trouble.blocked_desc: Sign-in or loading fails because your network blocks Telegram: how to check, switch network, use a VPN of your choice, and when to send logs.
trouble.blocked_h1: Sign-in or loading fails on a blocked network
trouble.blocked_logs: Send logs if the Telegram app opens and works on the same network but TMPlayer Music still cannot connect.
trouble.blocked_s1_p: Open a web page in your browser. If that fails, fix the connection first: finish a Wi-Fi login page, or switch mobile data on.
trouble.blocked_s2_h: Check the Telegram app on the same network
trouble.blocked_s2_p: If the Telegram app cannot connect either, the network is blocking it, and no setting in TMPlayer Music will change that.
trouble.blocked_s3_p: Switch from Wi-Fi to mobile data, or the other way round, and try again.
trouble.blocked_s4_h: Use a VPN of your choice
trouble.blocked_s4_p: TMPlayer Music has no proxy setting of its own: it uses the connection the phone gives it. A VPN app that covers the whole phone works with it. Pick one you trust, and follow the rules of the network and the country you are in.
trouble.blocked_sym: Sign-in stays on Connecting to Telegram, or the app says it cannot reach Telegram, or Telegram did not answer, or your chats load on one network and not on another.
trouble.blocked_title: Sign-in fails on a blocked network: TMPlayer Music
trouble.howto_intro: Work down the steps in order and stop when it works.
trouble.index_desc: Guides for the common problems in TMPlayer Music: sign-in on a blocked network, no tracks found, a track that will not play, a full phone and missing lyrics.
trouble.index_install: For problems installing the APK, see {a1}.
trouble.index_lede: Each guide says what you see, the likely causes, the steps to try and when to send logs. Start with the one that sounds like your problem.
trouble.index_report_p: If none of these fits, open an issue on GitHub and say what happened. Send logs is in the account menu and in Settings, About, and makes a text file with chat names, file names and phone numbers taken out first.
trouble.issue_p: Open an issue on GitHub with the app version (Settings, About), your phone and its Android version, and what happened. Attach the logs file if you can.
trouble.logs_how: Open the account menu at the top of Home and choose Send logs, or go to Settings, About, Send logs. Chat names, file names, phone numbers and secrets are taken out first, you pick the app the file goes to, and nothing is sent by itself.
trouble.lyrics_card: The lyrics page says No lyrics for this track, or that a lookup needs the length or a connection.
trouble.lyrics_cause1: Online lookups are off, either in Settings, Lyrics or because you answered Not now when the app asked.
trouble.lyrics_cause2: The lookup found no match. The track may not be in the lyrics source at all, or its title, artist or album tags are missing or spelt differently.
trouble.lyrics_cause3: The file does not say how long it is, and a lookup needs the length.
trouble.lyrics_cause4: The phone is offline, or the lookup is busy for a minute.
trouble.lyrics_cause5: A .lrc file exists but its name does not match the audio file, or it was sent to a different chat.
trouble.lyrics_desc: Lyrics are missing in TMPlayer Music: check the online lookup switch, the tags, the track length and how to name a matching .lrc file, and when to send logs.
trouble.lyrics_logs: Send logs if a .lrc file named like the audio file is in the same chat and the lyrics still do not show.
trouble.lyrics_s1_p: Open Settings, Lyrics and look at Look up lyrics and covers online. When it is off, only lyrics in the file's tags and .lrc files in the chat show.
trouble.lyrics_s2_p: On the lyrics page of a track with none, tap Search online. If it says lyrics are busy, wait a minute and try again. A lookup needs a connection.
trouble.lyrics_s3_h: Name the .lrc file like the audio file
trouble.lyrics_s3_p: The app looks for a .lrc file with the same name as the audio file, in the same chat. For song.flac, send song.lrc to that chat, then open the track's lyrics again.
trouble.lyrics_s4_p: Lookups use the title, artist and album from the file's tags, and the length for lyrics. A track whose tags are empty or wrong has little to look up.
trouble.lyrics_sym: The lyrics page says No lyrics for this track or No lyrics found, or that looking up lyrics needs the track's length or a connection.
trouble.noplay_card: A track spins, skips to the next, or shows an error such as Can't play this format.
trouble.noplay_cause1: The phone cannot play this format. MP3, FLAC, M4A, Ogg, Opus, WAV and AIFF play, and the Versions sheet says Can't play this format for one it cannot.
trouble.noplay_cause2: The connection dropped. A track streams from Telegram as you play it, so it needs the connection until enough has arrived. Tracks kept offline do not.
trouble.noplay_cause3: There is not enough free space for the cache. The app says how much the track needs and how much is free.
trouble.noplay_cause4: The message is gone: the track was deleted from its chat, or you left the chat.
trouble.noplay_desc: A track will not play in TMPlayer Music: format, connection, free space and deleted messages, with the steps to try and when to send logs.
trouble.noplay_logs: Send logs if a track in a common format, with free space and a good connection, still fails every time.
trouble.noplay_s1_h: Check the connection and try again
trouble.noplay_s1_p: Give a big file a moment: it starts as soon as enough has arrived. If it stalls, switch between Wi-Fi and mobile data and tap the track again.
trouble.noplay_s2_p: If the track shows Versions, open the sheet and tap another version. The app plays the version it can play by default, and you can choose one yourself.
trouble.noplay_s3_p: If the message talks about space, open Settings, Storage and use Free up space, or make room on the phone. The track then streams again.
trouble.noplay_s4_p: For tracks you want to play without a connection, use Keep offline in the track's menu. It checks the free space first.
trouble.noplay_sym: Tapping a track spins, skips to the next one, or shows an error such as Can't play this format or Not enough space to play this track.
trouble.noplay_title: A track will not play: TMPlayer Music
trouble.notracks_card: You picked chats, but Songs is empty, a chat says No audio in this chat, or some tracks are missing.
trouble.notracks_cause1: The scan is still running. A big chat takes time, and Settings, Library shows how far it has got.
trouble.notracks_cause2: The audio was sent as documents. The picker counts audio messages only, and files sent as documents are found by the scan.
trouble.notracks_cause3: Voice messages are never in the library, and clips under 30 seconds and voice recordings sent as files are hidden until you turn them on.
trouble.notracks_cause4: Telegram restricts the file, so the app skips it.
trouble.notracks_cause5: Track details wait for Wi-Fi: the tracks are found, but albums and covers are read on Wi-Fi by default.
trouble.notracks_cause6: The chat is not in Manage chats, or you left it.
trouble.notracks_desc: No tracks found in TMPlayer Music: the scan, audio sent as documents, hidden clips and voice recordings, restricted files and Wi-Fi only track details.
trouble.notracks_h1: No tracks found in the chats you picked
trouble.notracks_logs: Send logs if the scan has finished, the chat holds audio files of a common format, and the library is still empty.
trouble.notracks_s1_p: Open Settings, Library. It says whether the app is scanning, reading track details or waiting for Telegram. You can keep listening while it runs.
trouble.notracks_s2_p: Tap Check for new tracks now in Settings, Library, or Look for new tracks in Manage chats.
trouble.notracks_s3_p: Open Manage chats and look for the chat. If it is missing, use Add chats. A chat that could not be read shows why, and Try these again retries it.
trouble.notracks_s4_h: Show short clips and voice recordings
trouble.notracks_s4_p: In Settings, Library, turn on Show short clips or Show voice recordings if the missing files are those. A track whose length is not known yet is always shown.
trouble.notracks_s5_h: Allow track details on mobile data
trouble.notracks_s5_p: If it says track details wait for Wi-Fi, connect to Wi-Fi, or turn on Read track details on mobile data in Settings, Library. The tracks you open or play get theirs on any connection.
trouble.notracks_sym: You picked chats, but Songs is empty, a chat says No audio in this chat, or some tracks you expect are missing.
trouble.storage_card: A message says Not enough space, or the phone is running low on storage.
trouble.storage_cause1: The cache has grown. Audio you play is kept so it does not download twice, and with no limit set it keeps growing.
trouble.storage_cause2: Tracks kept offline take space on purpose, and Free up space never removes them.
trouble.storage_cause3: The phone itself is nearly full, with the app's share only a part of it.
trouble.storage_desc: Storage is full with TMPlayer Music: see what the cache holds, use Free up space, lower the cache limit, remove offline copies, and when to send logs.
trouble.storage_logs: Send logs if Free up space says it could not, or the numbers in Settings, Storage do not add up with what the phone reports.
trouble.storage_s1_p: Open Settings, Storage. It shows Cached audio and how much is free on the device.
trouble.storage_s2_p: Free up space deletes the cached audio. Your songs stay in the library and stream again when you play them, nothing in Telegram is touched, and tracks you kept offline stay.
trouble.storage_s3_p: Pick a smaller Cache limit in the same section. The cache never takes more than a share of the device's storage.
trouble.storage_s4_p: Open Kept offline in Settings and remove tracks, or Remove all. The files on the phone are deleted, the tracks stay in your chats, and you can keep them again later.
trouble.storage_s5_p: If the phone is full of other things, clear those too. The app cannot free space it does not own.
trouble.storage_sym: A message says Not enough space to play this track, or keeping tracks offline or an update stops for lack of space, or the phone itself is low on storage.
